episodes.title: Barmherzigkeit
episodes.summary: Sick young nanny Ida stumbles into the Berlin Charité hospital. Dr. Robert Koch's work on a tuberculosis cure attracts two physicians and an actress.

episodes.title: Kaiserwetter
episodes.summary: Spinola repays Behring for saving a life. Ida is urged to pursue an ambitious dream. Koch receives two visitors: a Tokyo doctor and the new emperor.

episodes.title: Das Licht der Welt
episodes.summary: Koch reveals big news at the congress while Ehrlich struggles to find a doctor to deliver his wife's breech baby. Tischendorf and Ida's romance blooms.

episodes.title: Wundermittel
episodes.summary: Nurse Therese falls ill. Koch tests tuberculin on humans, starting with himself. Behring reaches a breakthrough in his work on a diphtheria cure.

episodes.title: Götterdämmerung
episodes.summary: Despite worrying results, demand for tuberculin overwhelms the Charité. Behring's diphtheria cure is put to the test. Ida meets Tischendorf's father.

episodes.title: Zeitenwende
episodes.summary: Koch fails in one aspect of his life, but succeeds in another. Ehrlich faces a betrayal and increasing anti-Semitism. Ida rethinks her future plans.

episodes.title: Heimatschuss
episodes.summary: In 1943, a medical student seeks to use a soldier's case for her psychiatry dissertation, while her brother tries to prevent the man's court-martial.

episodes.title: Schwere Geburt
episodes.summary: In hospital, Anni gets a high-profile roommate. Dr. Sauerbruch welcomes forced recruit Dr. Jung, who shares shocking news he heard on the forbidden BBC.

episodes.title: Letzte Hoffnung
episodes.summary: Anni and Artur secretly treat Karin. A colleague begs Sauerbruch to rescue his ill son-in-law from jail. Martin tells Otto why he reports to the police.

episodes.title: Verschüttet
episodes.summary: Margot and Jung catch Miss Fritsch and Kolbe red-handed. Anni and Artur suffer a setback. Sauerbruch goes to Switzerland, leaving Dohnanyi vulnerable.

episodes.title: Im Untergrund
episodes.summary: Nurse Christel presses Otto for an engagement. Artur makes arrangements for Karin behind Anni's back. A coup attempt has consequences for Sauerbruch.

episodes.title: Stunde Null
episodes.summary: As German defeat becomes inevitable, the Charité staff struggle to treat patients without supplies and await the Russians' arrival with mixed feelings.
